properties.name: United Kingdom of Israel
properties.note: Approximate reconstruction of Saul/David/Solomon-era territory ("from Dan to Beersheba" plus Transjordan), based on standard Bible atlas depictions — not precise survey data. Dates c. 1047–930 BC per verified historical consensus; exact borders are not archaeologically fixed.

properties.name: Israel
properties.note: Approximate reconstruction of the northern kingdom's territory after the split from Judah, based on standard Bible atlas depictions — not precise survey data. Dates c. 930–722 BC per verified historical consensus.

properties.name: Judah
properties.note: Approximate reconstruction of the southern kingdom's territory after the split from Israel, based on standard Bible atlas depictions — not precise survey data. Dates c. 930–586 BC per verified historical consensus (fall of Jerusalem).
